summary: Foreign exchange markets are primarily driven by a firming U.S. dollar, which is supported by upcoming central bank decisions and safe-haven demand prompted by AI sector jitters. Meanwhile, the euro and British pound have both slipped against the greenback amid broader risk-off sentiment in the wider markets. Focus remains heavily on upcoming monetary policy announcements and Treasury yield movements.

outlook.reason: The euro is slipping as the dollar rebounds and AI-driven risk-off sentiment weighs on the currency.
The pound is edging lower as a firm dollar and a broader risk-off sell-off pressure the currency.
The dollar is steadying while AI jitters spur safe-haven yen gains, leaving the pair generally range-bound ahead of BoJ decisions.
Treasury yields hovering near multi-week lows and AI-related worries are fueling safe-haven demand.
